subtitleEn: Welcome to SCCD. We invite passionate and creative individuals to join our program and explore the world of communications design.
subtitleZh: 歡迎對媒體傳達設計充滿熱情的朋友們，報考實踐大學媒體傳達設計學系，一起探索設計的無限可能。
announcementDescEn: Please refer to Shih Chien University's admissions system for admission pathways.
announcementDescZh: 入學管道見實踐大學招生系統。
summerCampDescEn: SCCD Summer Camp offers high school students an immersive introduction to communications design, blending creative workshops, studio visits, and hands-on projects.
summerCampDescZh: 暑期設計體驗營為高中生提供沉浸式的媒體傳達設計入門體驗，結合創意工作坊、工作室參訪與實作專題，讓學生提前感受設計學習的樣貌。
